info.name: MyRobo — Yangi modullar (v0.0.28)
info.description:
Faqat ushbu sessiyada qo'shilgan/yangilangan API'lar: Teglar+arxiv (Course/Article), Gamification (Rank/XP/Sertifikat), Projects, Competitions, Community (Forum).

`base_url` production domeniga (`https://myrobo.uz`) sozlangan.

Login qilish uchun asosiy "MyRobo Backend API" kolleksiyasidagi Auth (Users) papkasini ishlating — u yerda olingan `access_token` shu kolleksiyada ham ishlaydi (collection variable orqali qo'lda ko'chiring yoki shu yerda ham login so'rovini bajaring).

item.name: Tags + Archive (Course/Article)
item.description: Mavjud Course/Article modellariga qo'shilgan teg va arxiv funksionalligi.

request.description: Yangi: ?tag=<slug> bo'yicha filtr. Arxivlangan kurslar avtomatik yashiriladi.
Yangi: is_archived va tag query parametrlari.
`tags` — Tag UUID(lar), bir nechta bo'lsa bir xil keyni qayta qo'shing.

item.name: Gamification (Rank/XP/Certificate)
item.description: Yangi: rank bosqichlari, XP tarixi, sertifikat, reyting jadvali.

request.description: status='completed' qilinganda avtomatik +50 XP beriladi (bir marta).
